name: PostHog
description: PostHog is a product intelligence platform that combines product analytics, web analytics, session replay, feature flags, experiments, and a customer data pipeline so teams can understand and improve user behavior.
best_for: Product teams and developers at companies of any size wanting analytics, experimentation, and data infrastructure in one platform, with SDKs for Next.js, React, Python, and 20+ other frameworks/languages.
features: Feature flags and no-code A/B testing experiments
Error tracking and AI observability (traces and logs)
Customer data platform (CDP) for routing event data to other tools
Managed data warehouse for querying product data

alternatives.name: Amplitude
alternatives.description: A product analytics platform combining analytics, feedback, experimentation, and feature management.
alternatives.best_for: Product, data, and engineering teams needing analytics with feature experimentation.

alternatives.name: Mixpanel
alternatives.description: A product intelligence platform combining analytics, session replay, experiments, and AI-powered insights.
alternatives.best_for: Product, data, and engineering teams wanting fast, data-driven product decisions.

alternatives.name: Segment
alternatives.description: Twilio's customer data platform for collecting, unifying, and activating first-party customer data.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations that primarily need a data pipeline to unify and route customer data across many tools.
